description: --filter (T9.9, B23d): the config's `filter` is a CommonJS module loaded in Jest's own process, plain `require`. Its `setup` runs once before the first filtering; the function gets each project's test paths (absolute) and returns `{ filtered }`, the ones that run. Here it drops `skipme.test.ts`. calls.txt records the order setup, then the paths it got (sorted, relative), then the count. A black-box run.
